metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.1 · 2005 · Jesse Stone: Stone Cold
metas.description: Jesse Stone (Selleck) is a New England police chief investigating a series of murders, in an adaptation of Robert B. Parker's novel.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.2 · 2006 · Jesse Stone: Night Passage
metas.description: In this prequel to 'Stone Cold,' Tom Selleck reprises his role as Jesse Stone, an L.A. cop who relocates to a small town only to find himself immersed in one mystery after the other.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.1 · 2006 · Jesse Stone: Death in Paradise
metas.description: A body's found on the shore of a lake. Police Chief Jesse Stone starts an investigation. It turns out to be a pregnant high school student. There's also a case of a persistent wife beater. Jesse starts seeing a shrink and dating.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.1 · 2007 · Jesse Stone: Sea Change
metas.description: Police Chief Jesse Stone's shrink recommends looking into old, unsolved cases to reduce drinking by staying busy. Of 3 cases before his time, he starts on the killing of a bank teller. He's also investigating an alleged rape.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.1 · 2009 · Jesse Stone: Thin Ice
metas.description: Jesse Stone and Captain Healy are shot during an unauthorized stake-out in Boston. Meanwhile, a cryptic letter sent from Paradise leads the mother of a kidnapped child to Stone. Though her son was declared dead, she hopes he will ...

metas.name: 6 · ★ 7.2 · 2010 · Jesse Stone: No Remorse
metas.description: Police Chief Jesse Stone's suspended in Paradise. He helps a friend as "temp" with a serial killer in Boston. He gets his first cellphone to avoid calls from his ex. Paradise PD's way over its head with a convenience store robbery...

metas.name: 7 · ★ 7.1 · 2011 · Jesse Stone: Innocents Lost
metas.description: After his involuntary retirement, Jesse Stone investigates the suspicious death of a young friend while the Paradise police force deals with the arrogant new chief, who is the son-in-law of a town councilman.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 7.1 · 2012 · Jesse Stone: Benefit of the Doubt
metas.description: Jesse Stone comes out of involuntary retirement after the new chief who replaced him was blown up, along with another officer in their police car. Jesse is forced to solve the crime on his own since all the other officers have quit.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 7.3 · 2015 · Jesse Stone: Lost in Paradise
metas.description: Jesse investigates the grim works of a serial killer in Boston and becomes concerned with a wayward teen in Paradise.
